data.body:
CLOSING on Gerrit change 1123 = Verified +1 (commit d09784c6b).

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA, each with its evidence:

- Sampling rejection reclassified to the typed config error, NOT LLMUnavailableError:
  test_a_sampling_rejection_is_translated_before_the_broad_classification asserts
  `type(caught.value) is LLMConfigError`. `type(...) is` is mandatory here and the AC now says
  so: LLMConfigError SUBCLASSES LLMUnavailableError, so an isinstance check passes even if the
  translation is dropped entirely.
- Raised TYPE unchanged for all three arms: test_a_budget_stop_is_not_swallowed_by_the_broad_arm,
  test_a_typed_llm_error_is_not_reclassified_by_the_broad_arm,
  test_an_unrelated_400_keeps_its_outage_classification.
- Disposition attached as METADATA without changing the raised type:
  test_the_broad_arm_attaches_a_disposition_without_changing_the_raised_type asserts BOTH
  `.outcome is not None` AND `type(err) is LLMUnavailableError`.
- End-to-end through the real run():
  test_runner_surfaces_a_sampling_rejection_as_the_typed_config_error — a run() that stopped
  calling the seam would pass every isolated unit test and fail this one.
- runner.py before/after LOC in the commit message, under 700 on THIS commit:
  782 -> 699, recorded in d09784c6b. CI CONFIRMS IT: change 1123 is Verified +1, while its
  ancestors 1121 (cc33) and 1122 (ADR) are Verified -1 on exactly one test,
  test_structured_run_seam.py::test_runner_regains_real_headroom_under_the_cap — measured
  runner.py is 782 at both of those commits and 699 at this one. That is the guard doing its
  job, and it is the operator-overridden ancestor case, not a defect in this change.
- Monkeypatch repoints: NONE, measured not assumed (no `setattr(runner_mod, ...)` target lies in
  the except spine).
- No comment lost a fact: the first implementer pass reached 698 by DELETING measured content
  (the anthropic.py:1611-1616 citation, the "structured-output retry path is untouched"
  invariant, "every model_override test pins the string behavior", the "retry-to-exhaustion"
  failure-mode name). I rejected that pass and re-dispatched with a compress-wording-only rule;
  all six facts verified restored by grep at 699.

HELD-OUT TDD, as actually run: 15 tests authored and confirmed RED; the implementer was given
ONLY the 3 happy-path tests, with the other 12 physically removed from its tree. On restore all
15 passed. THREE MUTATIONS each turned held-out tests red — disable the sampling translation
(2 fail, incl. the E2E), drop the UsageLimitExceeded arm (2 fail), drop the LLMError arm
(2 fail) — so the ordering assertions have teeth and are not tautologies.

FULL SUITE: 8237 passed, 74 skipped, 0 failed. make lint 0, make typecheck 0.

ONE CORRECTION TO THIS TICKET'S OWN PLAN, since the plan text is wrong and would mislead the
next reader: it said to retarget test_llm_failure_matrix.py's CURRENT(<file>:<line>) markers
"WITHOUT a line number" so they cannot rot again. That is WRONG. Those markers are VALIDATED by
test_every_matrix_case_pins_a_current_source_seam, which asserts the anchor contains ":" followed
by digits, and whose docstring states the brittleness is deliberate — "so a later story flipping
a row is forced to update the cited seam". Removing the numbers defeats a designed forcing
function; I only caught it because I ran the test after making the edit. The commit therefore
retargets 19 markers to REAL anchors (structured_run.py:84 the LLMRunnerError step-budget arm,
:95 the typed LLMError passthrough, :131 the broad LLMUnavailableError construction) and
deliberately LEAVES two pointing at runner.py because they are not this ticket's seams —
runner.py:502 (per-call req.config may only RAISE the operator floor: the usage-limits region
task 8229 extracts) and runner.py:579 (valid-JSON wrong-schema exhausting the bounded output
retry). A blanket replace would have swapped a stale-but-honest line number for a confidently
WRONG symbol name.
